<!-- Contribution template 1.1.0, 2026-10-14. -->

## Change

What problem does this solve, and what changes for users or developers?
Link the relevant issue and existing design when applicable.

## Validation

Which checks ran, on which version/target? Include failures and important gaps.
For crypto, isolation or release-critical changes, link the separate verification
and identify whether it was automated, assistant review or human review.

## Review

Note material AI assistance and how its output was checked, if applicable.
State any maintainer decision needed for this revision. Merge acceptance does
not authorize device/system changes, package publication or upstream submission.
